# dagsterplus_configuration_document (Data Source)

Converts a YAML configuration document to JSON for use with the Dagster+ API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_configuration_document" "example" {
  yaml_body = <<-YAML
    run_queue:
      max_concurrent_runs: 10
    run_monitoring:
      enabled: true
  YAML
}

output "settings_json" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_configuration_document.example.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `yaml_body` (String) The configuration document as a YAML string.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The configuration document as a JSON string.
